comment: Usage tiers and contribution requirements are proposed without defining the technical and governance data needed to measure usage accurately. This may be difficult where shared infrastructure is federated or implemented across multiple operators.

anchor.note: p.56 l.Lines 327-332 read as the printed page; section 3.4.3 agrees

public.text: Usage tiers and contribution requirements are proposed without defining the technical and governance data needed to measure usage accurately. This may be difficult where shared infrastructure is federated or implemented across multiple operators.
public.suggestedRevision: Require consistent service metering, privacy-preserving usage measurement, agreed attribution rules, auditable cost models, and governance review before usage data is used to impose restrictions or charges.
